text:
anna (product): Quick GA callout — Nova Generator (hosted) is going GA today at 10:00 PT. New streaming endpoint /v3/generate-stream supports tool-calling and structured outputs. Rolling canaries + infra notes below.

lucas (release): Rolling window 10:00-12:00 PT. Canary stages: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Canary keys + rollout sheet in #eng-releases secrets. @samira will watch metrics.

samira (eng): Infra green. Runtime has nova-optimized kernels and improved KV cache handling. We adjusted default batch_by_latency to favor p50 latency on xlarge shapes. Logs aggregated under /ops/logs/nova-generator.

mike (ops): Ops checklist (brief): update routing policy to include cost-aware fallback, enable healthcheck /health/nova, ensure synthetic traffic runs. Pager policy: alert @hugo if error_rate > 5% sustained for 3m.

hugo (eng-oncall): @mike oncall window confirmed 09:30-13:30 PT. I'll be monitoring Datadog dashboard "Hosted / Nova Generator" and the new trace view. Ping me in #incidents if anything spikes.

release-bot: Deploy started at 10:05 PT — canary initiated (commit=abc123). Canary key: canary-nova-01.

dev-bot: SDK patch v1.12.0 published with v3 generate-stream client and a backcompat flag for older tool-call shapes. npm: https://npmjs.com/package/redwood-sdk (v1.12.0).

anna (product): Migration & compatibility notes: default model name is "redwood/nova-v1". We will NOT auto-migrate existing routes pinned to other models (e.g., redwood/mosaic). Customers must opt-in. No immediate deprecation of mosaic.

samira (eng): Known issue: tool-call payloads with nested args >8KB may be truncated during streaming. Temporary guard returns code 413 with helpful message. Fix is scheduled for next sprint; workaround: chunk the payload or upload large blobs via presigned link.

mike (ops): Ops playbook (short link): https://confluence.redwood/inference/nova-rollout — rollback steps:
1) flip feature flag nova_disable
2) revert routing to model=mosaic-lite
3) disable canary keys and notify customers via status.redwood.com

lucas (release): Post-rollout tasks: add Nova to cost-per-token dashboards, update sample prompts/snippets in docs, schedule 2pm PT cross-team readout and retro. CS and account reps have been notified to triage early adopter questions.

anna (product): TL;DR: GA live, streaming + tool-calling endpoint available, SDK updated, canaries rolling. If you see anomalies, ping #incidents and @hugo. :tada:

samira (eng): Example usage (node):
```js
const res = await client.generateStream({
  model: 'redwood/nova-v1',
  endpoint: '/v3/generate-stream',
  toolCalls: true
});
for await (const chunk of res) console.log(chunk);
```

lucas (release): Note for Dedicated customers: Dedicated & Private deployments will get an opt-in build; reps have the enablement checklist.

mike (ops): Turning on synthetic monitors in 5m. Will post a short status update after first canary completes. :rocket:

anna (product): Thanks everyone — keeping this channel as the single source for rollout chatter. Planning to pin the rollout sheet and the post-rollout readout notes here.
